theorem OAllCharacterClosure.both_tests_original_PA_source_zero.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure] [addHaar.Regular]
  [inst_8 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [inst_9 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [inst_10 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_11 : SFinite mu] [inst_12 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] (a l r s : ℝ)
  (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi),
  have tests := ⋯;
  have A0 := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (DReview.sharp K phi) ⋯ ⋯;
  have A1 :=
    PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs
      (DReview.sharp K fun x => ↑(Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) * phi x) ⋯ ⋯;
  have S := (OAllCharacterClosure.originalThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection;
  have P := 1 - S;
  (P.comp A0).comp S = 0 ∧ (P.comp A1).comp S = 0 :=

theorem OCharacterAmbient.interval_residual_is_component_projection.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [inst_4 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) [inst_5 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (chi : MasulloGRH.UnitaryHeckeCharacter K) (a : ℝ)
  [inst_6 : SFinite mu] [inst_7 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] (l r : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r)
  (h : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h) (hc : HasCompactSupport h),
  ∀ F ∈ OCharacterAmbient.compactCharacterSpace K mu ((r - l) / 2) s ⋯ hs chi,
    (OCharacterAmbient.componentSpectralSpace K mu ((r - l) / 2) s ⋯ hs addHaar chi (a + (l + r) / 2)).starProjection
        ((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h hh hc) F) =
      (PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h hh hc) F -
        (JThetaAttachment.thetaClosure K addHaar mu chi (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s).starProjection
          ((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs h hh hc) F) :=
